evals.name: approved partial feature remains draft
evals.prompt: Refine feature ticket FEAT-42 using this user-supplied ticket text (tracker provider is none): 'Reviewers need a reusable saved filter for changes requiring attention. The filter should be easy to name and reuse.' Work with me to produce one reviewer's use case and one testable product-level requirement. I approve writing the graph items now. I have not confirmed the component design or that the feature is estimatable, and I do not approve changing an external ticket. Leave the requirement draft, record the open component question, and show the manual TSPEC refinement section.
evals.expected_output: Creates a use_case and a level=product requirement linked by leads_to; both carry featureTicketId=FEAT-42. The requirement remains draft, an unresolved component-design question is explicit, no external API is called, and a manual section is shown.

expectations.text: Approved partial refinement creates graph items.
New feature graph items share the existing ticket identifier.
Refinement records the agreed use case.
The use case links to its derived product requirement.
Incomplete refinement does not advance the requirement.
Provider none returns a manual ticket-section draft.

evals.name: ticket update needs separate approval
evals.prompt: The existing feature ticket FEAT-42 says: 'Reviewers need a reusable saved filter for changes requiring attention.' Tracker provider is none. Refine it into a complete, estimatable use case and product/component requirements; I approve saving those graph items and confirm the requirements are estimatable. Prepare the exact TSPEC refinement section, but I have not approved changing a ticket. Do not write a ticket; show the section for review.
evals.expected_output: Builds and validates the approved graph, advances user-confirmed estimatable requirements through reviewed to approved, and previews a section with readiness and graph IDs/titles/repository-relative paths; no ticket write occurs without separate approval.

expectations.text: User-approved graph is persisted before ticket update approval.
Confirmed estimatable requirements reach approved state.
Shows the exact ticket section preview.
Reports readiness based on the user confirmation.
No-skill run has no provider write access through the fixture.
